title: 眉毛少还能做吗？先看基础与设计边界
title_en: Can very sparse brows be designed?
intro: 是否适合、能做到什么程度，都需要看具体基础。野生眉通过线条与颜色形成视觉表达，不是真实长出新的眉毛。
intro_en: Suitability and achievable detail depend on the starting point. Hair-stroke pigmentation creates a visual effect with lines and colour; it does not grow new hairs.

sections.title: 先分清缺少什么
sections.description: 框架完整但颜色淡，与接近无眉、局部断眉或缺眉尾，不是同一个问题。先观察已有毛发与底色，再讨论轮廓。
sections.description_en: An intact but faint brow differs from an almost absent brow, a local gap or a missing tail. Observe existing hairs and pigment before discussing the outline.

sections.title: 结构和密度要分开考虑
sections.description: 主线条负责框架和主要毛流；绒毛线在适合采用组合的项目里补充层次与过渡。线条并非越多越自然，要保留合理的间距和虚实。
sections.description_en: Main strokes establish structure and primary direction. Fine strokes can add layers and transitions where that combination is appropriate. More lines do not automatically look more natural; spacing and tonal variation matter.

sections.title: 先画出方案
sections.description: 免费到店设计约30–45分钟。乐乐老师会结合骨骼结构与想要的气质画出眉形，适合再做，不适合的情况会说明。
sections.description_en: A free design consultation takes about 30–45 minutes. Lele considers the existing bone structure and the desired character, draws the proposed shape and discusses any limits before a decision is made.
